in_sanskrit.name: अव्यान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who goes beyond the limits of knowledge, understanding, and perception, an unmeasurable entity.

in_hindi.name: अव्यान
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is beyond the physical world and the senses, an unmanifested entity.

in_tamil.name: அவ்யான்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is beyond the known or understood, a divine or supernatural entity.

in_telugu.name: అవ్యాన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is beyond all measure, limitless or infinite.

in_marathi.name: Avyaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avyaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avyaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'av-yaj-nan', meaning 'knowledgeable', 'learned'. It is a name of great respect and reverence, given to children who are expected to carry on the wisdom and knowledge of their ancestors.
